summary.text: HOVDEN SENIOR AS is a private limited company registered in Ulsteinvik, founded 1995-05-01. Hovden Senior AS is registered for fishing and hunting (fangst). It also participates in other companies with economic activity as a purpose. Its main industry code is 03.110: marine fishing. The register shows 23 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 111 629 961 NOK and the annual result was 14 292 941 NOK; operating income was up from 63 687 869 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 8 952 688 NOK in 2024 to 14 292 941 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 43 355 514 NOK in 2024 to 55 637 204 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is hovdensenior.no. It holds a Legal Entity Identifier (98450099782F3A6S1052). The registered employee count went from 25 on 2025-12-13 to 23 on 2026-09-15. Recent changes in the register: business address set to Bjørndalvegen 7 on 2026-09-04; share capital set to 72 405 on 2026-06-16.
